items.difficulty_reason: The proof is a covering-refinement chain: pick \'etale charts V \to Y, U \to X \times_Y V, U_i \to X_i \times_X U, note the composites give \tau-coverings by schemes, and read off the displayed three-step equivalence f has P_spaces <=> U \to V has P <=> each U_i \to V has P <=> each X_i \to Y has P_spaces, whose middle step is exactly \tau-locality on the source for the scheme property. The chart selection and the bookkeeping that \{U_i \to U\} is a \tau-covering of schemes are the substance.
